title: kb_mcp.py --register-local --project on a missing directory says the claude CLI is not installed
goal: kb_mcp.py --register-local --project DIR names a DIR that does not exist as the cause with exit 2, not that the claude CLI is not installed

run: import subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py','--register-local','--project','/nonexistent-kb-project-dir'],capture_output=True,text=True);o=p.stdout+p.stderr;print(p.returncode,o.strip()[:200]);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==2 and 'not installed' not in o else 1)
